stories.headline: TerraVolt Signs 55,000 MMBTU/Day Natural Gas Deal for Idaho AI Data Center Campus

key_facts.excerpt: CalEthos, Inc. and its subsidiary TerraVolt Infrastructure, Inc. today announced the execution of an agreement with a top-tier natural gas marketing company for the FIRM supply to the Company of natural gas for TerraVolt's planned behind-the-meter onsite power plant. key_facts.fact: CalEthos says the project aligns with President Trump's March 4, 2026 Ratepayer Protection Pledge, which requires technology companies to pay for the power infrastructure needed to support their expanding data centers.

stories.headline: Cowboy Space (ex-Aetherflux) Raises $275M Series B at $2B for Orbital AI Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Cowboy Space Corporation, founded in 2024 by Robinhood co-founder Baiju Bhatt, announced a $275 million Series B at a $2 billion post-money valuation on May 11, 2026, alongside a rebrand from Aetherflux and a pivot into orbital AI data centers and rockets.
key_facts.excerpt: The company formerly known as Aetherflux has raised a $275M Series B—and has embarked on an ambitious pivot to dramatically expand its space-solar-power business to include orbital data centers and rockets... Aetherflux is rebranding to Cowboy Space Corporation.

key_facts.fact: Index Ventures led the round, with participation from IVP, Blossom Capital, SAIC, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, Interlagos and Bhatt himself.
key_facts.excerpt: The round was led by Index Ventures, with participation from new investors IVP, Blossom Capital and SAIC, alongside existing backers Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, Interlagos and Bhatt himself.

key_facts.fact: Cowboy plans a launch vehicle whose upper stage doubles as a 1-megawatt data center in orbit, replacing the conventional rocket-plus-payload split; first satellite launches this year and first rocket no earlier than end-2028.

stories.headline: eBay Board Rejects GameStop's $56B Takeover as 'Neither Credible Nor Attractive'

key_facts.fact: eBay's board concluded GameStop's unsolicited $125-per-share, half cash/half stock proposal valuing the company at roughly $56B is 'neither credible nor attractive'.
key_facts.excerpt: EBay Inc. (Nasdaq: EBAY) has rejected an unsolicited acquisition proposal from GameStop, stating that the company's Board of Directors has concluded that the proposal is neither credible nor attractive.

key_facts.fact: The board cited eBay's standalone prospects, uncertainty over GameStop's financing, leverage and operational risks of the combined entity, and leadership structure concerns.
key_facts.excerpt: Factors such as eBay's standalone prospects, uncertainty regarding GameStop's financing proposal, the impact of the proposal on eBay's long-term growth and profitability, the leverage, operational risks, and leadership structure of a combined entity.

key_facts.fact: GameStop, with a market value around $11–12B and roughly $9.4B in cash and liquid investments, had a 'highly-confident letter' from TD Securities for up to $20B, leaving an unfunded gap of about $16B on the $56B deal.
key_facts.excerpt: Cohen said GameStop had about $9.4 billion in cash and liquid investments as of January 31 ... GameStop has 'a highly-confident letter from TD Securities for up to $20 billion' ... leaving a gap of $16 billion to complete the $56 billion deal.

key_facts.fact: GameStop's CEO Ryan Cohen had said he is prepared to take the offer directly to shareholders in a proxy fight if eBay's board rejected it.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Bizengri for NRG1-Fusion Bile Duct Cancer, 7th Drug Under Priority Voucher Program

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Partner Therapeutics' Bizengri (zenocutuzumab-zbco) for adults with advanced, unresectable or metastatic NRG1 fusion-positive cholangiocarcinoma after progression on prior therapy — the first targeted therapy for the indication.
key_facts.excerpt: FDA has approved BIZENGRI (zenocutuzumab-zbco) for the treatment of adults with advanced, unresectable or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a neuregulin 1 (NRG1) gene fusion ... the first targeted therapy approved specifically for NRG1+ cholangiocarcinoma.

key_facts.fact: Approval was expedited through the FDA Commissioner's National Priority Voucher program — the seventh drug approved under the new pilot.
key_facts.excerpt: This approval marks the seventh approval under the Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (CNPV) pilot program.

key_facts.fact: The decision was based on the open-label, single-arm eNRGy trial of 22 patients (19 evaluable) showing a 36.8% confirmed overall response rate and duration of response of 2.8–12.9 months.
key_facts.excerpt: The efficacy of Bizengri was evaluated in a single-arm trial of 19 patients with NRG1 fusion-positive cholangiocarcinoma of which 36.8% had an overall response. The duration of response ranged from 2.8 months to 12.9 months.

key_facts.fact: Bizengri previously received accelerated approval in 2024 for NRG1-fusion non-small cell lung cancer and pancreatic adenocarcinoma after prior systemic therapy.
key_facts.excerpt: In 2024, Bizengri received accelerated approval for the treatment of adults with advanced unresectable or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer and pancreatic adenocarcinoma harboring a NRG1 gene fusion.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Roche's Ocrevus for Children 10 and Older With Relapsing-Remitting MS

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Roche/Genentech's Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) for children 10 and older weighing at least 25 kg with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis — only the second therapy formally approved for pediatric MS in the US.
key_facts.excerpt: The FDA has approved the infusion therapy Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) for treating children with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) who are ages 10 and older and weigh at least 55 pounds (25 kg) ... the second-ever therapy to win formal FDA approval for this indication.

key_facts.fact: Approval rested mainly on the Phase 3 OPERETTA 2 trial in 187 children and adolescents comparing Ocrevus head-to-head with Gilenya (fingolimod) over two years.
key_facts.excerpt: The new FDA approval for the treatment of pediatric MS was based mainly on data from a Phase 3 clinical trial called OPERETTA 2 (NCT05123703), which enrolled 187 children and adolescents with MS.

key_facts.fact: Patients on Ocrevus had a 48% lower risk of relapse versus oral Gilenya, with a 48% reduction in new or enlarging lesions and 87% fewer actively inflamed lesions.
key_facts.excerpt: Patients treated with Ocrevus had a 48% lower risk of relapse compared with those receiving the oral medication ... Ocrevus significantly reduced the number of patients with new or enlarging MS lesions by 48% and also lowered the number of participants with actively inflamed lesions by 87%.

key_facts.fact: No participants discontinued Ocrevus due to side effects in the trial, while three withdrew on Gilenya; the safety profile was consistent with adult experience.
key_facts.excerpt: No side effects led to treatment discontinuation in the Ocrevus group, whereas three participants withdrew in the Gilenya group.

Notably absent from the attendees is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

key_facts.fact: A White House source said Huang was not invited because the trip is focused on agriculture and commercial aviation matters such as Boeing aircraft orders.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang did not get an invite because the White House wants to focus more on agriculture and aviation, Reuters reported. Nvidia has become a major geopolitical bargaining chip between the two superpowers.

key_facts.excerpt: His absence from the trip could potentially hinder his efforts to sell Nvidia's AI chips to China, a market he has identified as a $50 billion opportunity. This comes after Huang expressed his willingness to join the president on the anticipated trip.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's H200 chips were approved by Commerce in recent weeks under a 25% revenue-sharing arrangement, but Commerce Secretary Lutnick said on April 22 that no shipments had actually moved because Chinese buyers have not received permission from Beijing to import them.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump has developed a strong relationship with [Huang] since he has been in office and agreed to allow the company's H200 AI chips to be exported to China. stories.headline: OpenAI-Microsoft Revenue Share Capped at $38B vs. $135B Earlier Trajectory

key_facts.fact: OpenAI and Microsoft have agreed to cap total revenue-sharing payments at $38 billion, The Information reported on May 11, 2026, citing a person with knowledge of the arrangement.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI and Microsoft agreed to cap total revenue-sharing payments at $38 billion, U.S. digital news outlet The Information reported on Monday, citing a person with knowledge of the arrangement.

key_facts.fact: Under the prior terms, OpenAI's payments to Microsoft could have totaled roughly $135 billion through 2030 if long-term goals were met; the new cap is part of the partnership amendment unveiled in late April.
key_facts.excerpt: Source: new revenue sharing terms cap OpenAI's payments to Microsoft at $38B; they previously could have totaled $135B through 2030 if long-term goals were met (The Information)

key_facts.fact: Payments will continue through 2030 at the previously agreed 20% rate, independent of any OpenAI declaration of AGI, but now subject to the overall cap.
key_facts.excerpt: revenue share payments from OpenAI to Microsoft will be 'subject to a total cap,' but they will continue through 2030, 'independent of OpenAI's technology progress.'... OpenAI will pay Microsoft at the same percentage, which is 20%.

key_facts.fact: Investors expect the cap to strengthen OpenAI's IPO pitch; some executives have said an offering could come as soon as end-2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The payment cap could help OpenAI present a better financial picture to investors as it works toward a public offering, which some executives said could take place as soon as the end of this year.

key_facts.fact: The April amendment also ended Microsoft's exclusivity and stopped Microsoft's reverse revenue-share payments to OpenAI; Microsoft retains roughly 27% of OpenAI's for-profit arm.
key_facts.excerpt: The revenue sharing is also one way now, so Microsoft no longer has to pay 20 percent of its Azure OpenAI revenue back to OpenAI... Microsoft still owns around 27 percent of OpenAI's for-profit arm.

stories.headline: Reliance to Get 900+ Acres in Andhra Pradesh for 1.5 GW Hyperscale AI Data Center

key_facts.fact: The Andhra Pradesh government has agreed in principle to allot more than 900 acres near Bhogapuram International Airport to Reliance Industries for what will be India's largest AI-ready hyperscale data center cluster at 1.5 GW.
key_facts.excerpt: Reliance Industries Limited is set to receive more than 900 acres near Bhogapuram International Airport in Andhra Pradesh for establishing what is projected to be India's largest 1.5 GW AI-ready hyperscale data centre cluster.

key_facts.fact: The investment is valued at ₹1.6 lakh crore (~$19 billion), with formal clearance expected soon after approval from the State Investment Promotion Board.
key_facts.excerpt: The Andhra Pradesh Government has, in principle, agreed to allot three land parcels for the project, which has already secured approval from the State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB). Formal clearance for the proposed investment of ₹1.6 lakh crore is expected soon.

key_facts.fact: Reliance requested ~360 acres for phase one and 635 acres for phase two, plus additional land for a cable landing station and desalination plant. Power will come from captive solar generation and battery energy storage.
key_facts.excerpt: Reliance has sought around 360 acres for the first phase and 635 acres for the second phase. The company has also requested additional land for a cable landing station and a desalination plant. Power requirements are expected to be met through captive solar generation and battery energy storage systems.

key_facts.fact: The Reliance project follows the groundbreaking of Google's $15 billion, 1 GW data center at Taruluvada near Visakhapatnam, being developed with AdaniConneX and Nxtra by Airtel.

stories.headline: China's Robotera Raises Over $200M Led by SF Group to Scale Humanoid Robotics

key_facts.fact: Beijing-based Robotera raised over $200 million in a new round led by SF Group, with participation from HSG, IDG Capital, Hillhouse Investment, CICC Capital and several industrial partners including KENGIC, Dongfeng Asset Investment, ICBC Capital and funds affiliated with China Unicom.
key_facts.excerpt: Following its RMB 1 billion strategic round in March, robotics company ROBOTERA has raised over USD 200 million in a new financing round led by SF Group. The round also saw participation from leading financial investors including HSG, IDG Capital, Hillhouse Investment, CICC Capital, Jingming Capital, SparkEdge Capital, Luxin Venture Capital Group... alongside major industrial partners such as KENGIC, Dongfeng Asset Investment, ICBC Capital, and funds affiliated with China Unicom.

key_facts.fact: Robotera says it has reached the first product-market fit in embodied intelligence, with deployments across more than ten logistics centers in collaboration with China Post and SF Group; Q2 2026 saw thousand-unit deliveries with growth exceeding 300%.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has achieved the first product-market fit (PMF) in the embodied intelligence sector, with deployments across more than ten logistics centers in collaboration with China Post and SF Group. In Q2 2026, ROBOTERA initiated thousand-unit deliveries, with growth exceeding 300%.

key_facts.fact: Founded in August 2023 by Chen Jianyu, Robotera sells the L7 full-size bipedal humanoid (~171 cm), the STAR 1 model tested in the Gobi Desert and Great Wall, and the ERA-42 end-to-end embodied AI model.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in August 2023 by Chen Jianyu, Robotera is a humanoid robotics company. Its offers include: L7 (Full-Size Bipedal): Their flagship model, standing about 171 cm (5'7″) tall. STAR 1: A humanoid tested in extreme environments like the Gobi Desert and the Great Wall of China. ERA-42 Large Model: An end-to-end 'embodied AI' model.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines Unveils 'Interaction Models' for Real-Time Audio/Video AI

key_facts.fact: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab announced a research preview of 'interaction models' on May 11, 2026 — a new class of natively multimodal AI that processes audio, video and text in continuous 200ms micro-turns, listening, watching and responding simultaneously instead of in turn-taking style.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we're announcing a research preview of interaction models: models that handle interaction natively rather than through external scaffolding... they continuously take in audio, video, and text, and think, respond, and act in real time.

key_facts.fact: The lead system, TML-Interaction-Small, is a 276-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 12B active parameters, paired with a separate deeper-reasoning module to handle slower thinking.
key_facts.excerpt: The research preview introduces TML-Interaction-Small, a 276-billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 12 billion active parameters.

key_facts.fact: On the FD-bench interaction benchmark, the model reports a turn-taking latency of 0.40 seconds vs. 0.57s for Gemini-3.1-flash-live and 1.18s for GPT-realtime-2.0 (minimal).
key_facts.excerpt: Responsiveness: It achieved a turn-taking latency of 0.40 seconds, compared to 0.57s for Gemini-3.1-flash-live and 1.18s for GPT-realtime-2.0 (minimal).

key_facts.fact: Thinking Machines will open a limited research preview to collect feedback in the coming months and plans a wider release later this year; the model is not yet publicly available.
key_facts.excerpt: Thinking Machines plans to open a 'limited research preview' in the 'coming months' and aims to do a 'wider release later this year.'

key_facts.fact: Demos showed the model backchanneling during human speech, translating speech live, noticing a user slouching, and flagging an animal mentioned in a story.
key_facts.excerpt: Thinking Machines also shared several examples of the model in action, including listening for mentions of animals in a story, translating speech in real time, and telling someone when they're slouching.

stories.headline: US-Brokered Ukraine-Russia Three-Day Truce Expires; Drone Strikes Resume After Midnight

key_facts.fact: The three-day US-mediated ceasefire that ran from May 9 to May 11 expired after midnight on May 12, with Russian and Ukrainian monitoring channels reporting combat drone launches resuming almost immediately.
key_facts.excerpt: After midnight on May 12, the truce between Ukraine and Russia, which was supposed to last on May 9, 10, and 11, expired ... Shortly after the ceasefire ended, monitoring channels from both sides began reporting the launch of combat drones.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said on May 11 that Russia is preparing new attacks and reported the Ukrainian general staff had logged 133 attacks and nearly 5,000 drone launches across the front during the truce period.
key_facts.excerpt: Enemy launched nearly 5,000 drones and carried out 133 attacks - General Staff on the situation at the front ... Russia does not plan to end the war and is preparing new attacks - Zelenskyy 11.05.26

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha proposed Europe broker an 'airport ceasefire' restricting strikes on each side's airfields, after US-led talks stalled amid the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine's Foreign Minister, Andrii Sybiha, has suggested that Europe may increase its role in the Russia-Ukraine peace process by helping to broker an 'airport ceasefire' in which both sides agree to halt strikes on each other's airfields.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said Ukrainian negotiator Rustem Umerov met US envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Florida and discussed 'possible formats of meetings at the leadership level' to end the war.
key_facts.excerpt: Zelensky reported that Umerov met with the US leader's special envoy, Steve Witkoff, and the US leader's son-in-law, Jared Kushner ... 'Possible formats of meetings and negotiations at the leadership level were discussed in the United States.'

stories.headline: Vbot Raises ~$73M Pre-A, Sets Consumer Embodied AI Funding Record in China

key_facts.fact: Chinese embodied AI startup Vbot closed a Pre-A round of nearly 500 million yuan (~$73 million), co-led by Oriental Fortune Capital, Huatai Zijin Investment and Fosun RZ Capital, with participation from SAIC Motor's Shangqi Capital. The company calls it the largest single-round consumer embodied intelligence funding to date.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese embodied AI startup Vbot announced the completion of a Pre-A funding round of nearly 500 million yuan ($73 million), marking another massive financing deal in the sector. The round was co-led by Oriental Fortune Capital, Huatai Zijin Investment, and Fosun RZ Capital, with participation from institutions including SAIC Motor's Shangqi Capital.

key_facts.fact: Vbot started shipping its first product — the Vbot Super Robot Dog — on May 8, with the first batch of 500 units mass-produced and now being delivered through WeChat mini-program and JD.com.
key_facts.excerpt: Alongside the new funding, the company has started deliveries of its first product, a super robot dog, with the first batch of 500 units already mass-produced and currently shipping.

key_facts.fact: Vbot plans to increase production capacity to more than 2,500 units per month in June and will begin development of a full-size humanoid robot, including an Agentic OS for embodied applications.
key_facts.excerpt: The company plans to increase its production capacity to more than 2,500 units in June to accelerate fulfilling pre-orders and further expand its market share, according to Vbot... The company's core objective for the next phase is to initiate the hardware development of full-size humanoid robots and build a world model covering general manipulation and mobility capabilities.

key_facts.fact: Vbot was founded in late 2024 by Dr. Yu Yinan, who previously led work in autonomous driving at Horizon Robotics, and produces its robot dog to automotive-industry standards with 5-hour battery life.

stories.headline: Unitree Unveils GD01, World's First Production-Ready Manned Mecha

key_facts.fact: Chinese robotics company Unitree unveiled the GD01 on May 12, 2026, calling it the world's first production-ready manned transformable mecha, with a starting price of 3.9 million yuan (~$574,000).
key_facts.excerpt: Unitree unveiled the GD01, described as the world's first production-ready manned mecha, with a starting price of 3.9 million yuan ($574,090).

key_facts.fact: The GD01 weighs about 500 kg with a passenger inside and transforms between bipedal and quadrupedal configurations; founder Wang Xingxing piloted it in the launch video, walking forward and smashing a brick wall.
key_facts.excerpt: Approximately 500 kg with passenger; transitions between bipedal walking and quadruped configurations. Demo showed forward walking, brick-smashing capability, transitioning into quadruped mode.

key_facts.fact: Unitree ranked first globally in humanoid robot shipments in 2025 with revenue of 1.708 billion yuan (335.4% YoY growth) and is pursuing an IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market targeting 4.2 billion yuan (~$580 million).
